text:
Lina (Finance Lead): quick flag — partner credits from CloudPartner (invoice P-7712) were applied as immediate revenue instead of being amortized. this is hitting q4 close. can we triage?
Marcus (RevRec): details? amount and contract terms?
Lina (Finance Lead): total credit $30,000 issued 2026-03-05 as a partner incentive to offset customer invoices. contract states partner offset should be expensed/amortized over 6 months. billing system created revenue line: 
```
invoice_id: P-7712
line: Partner Incentive Credit
amount: 30000
rev_scope: RECOGNIZE_IMMEDIATE
```
Should be deferral schedule (PARTNER_CRED_6M).
Samantha (Billing): looks like billing rule matched the "credit" SKU to revenue by mistake. the export shows rev_scope=RECOGNIZE_IMMEDIATE. i can push a corrected export but we need direction on GL mapping and whether this is contra-revenue or marketing expense.
Ken (Tax): for tax/treatment, partner credits that reduce customer invoicing are contra-revenue. but accounting policy prefers deferred contra-revenue if tied to future performance. confirm RevRec guidance.
Marcus (RevRec): Agree with Ken. treatment: record contra-revenue deferral and amortize monthly. JE mapping: 
```
Initial (to reverse current immediate revenue):
Debit: Revenue - Partnerships 30000
Credit: Suspense/Adj 30000

Deferral JE:
Debit: Suspense/Adj 30000
Credit: Deferred Contra-Revenue - PARTNER_CRED_6M 30000

Monthly amortization (6 months):
Debit: Deferred Contra-Revenue 5000
Credit: Revenue - Partnerships 5000
```
Lina (Finance Lead): requested: need reversal + deferral posted before books close tomorrow. also need approval from CFO to change recognition policy for this large partner.
Ruth (CFO): approved for reversal + deferral. please include a one-paragraph memo describing why amortization is appropriate and the contract clause reference. i want sign-off stored in month-end binder.
Samantha (Billing): uploading corrected billing export to s3: s3://billing-exports/mar/P-7712-corrected.csv and updated invoice record note: "rev_scope -> PARTNER_CRED_6M (amortize over 6 months)". :white_check_mark:
InvoiceBot: Payment/credit applied for P-7712 on 2026-03-05 (txn_cp_77).
Marcus (RevRec): posting JEs now. reversal JE# 561010 (Debit Revenue Partnerships 30000 / Credit Suspense 30000). deferral JE# 561011 (Debit Suspense 30000 / Credit Deferred Contra-Revenue 30000).
Ken (Tax): will review memo for tax footnote impact. also flag for state apportionment checks.
Lina (Finance Lead): thanks. Marcus, can you confirm monthly schedule start date?
Marcus (RevRec): schedule PARTNER_CRED_6M starts 2026-03-31, 6 equal monthly reductions of 5000. RevRecBot will pick up schedule on next run.
RevRecBot: deferral schedule PARTNER_CRED_6M created for invoice P-7712. next recognition posting scheduled 2026-03-31.
Ruth (CFO): noted and approved. Lina please add the signed memo to the month-end approvals folder.
Lina (Finance Lead): will do. closing thread once memo uploaded. thanks everyone.
Samantha (Billing): quick follow-up: i've filed a billing rule change request to prevent instant-recognition mapping on partner credit SKUs. ticket #BR-2345.
Marcus (RevRec): +1 on rule. also adding a validation in rev engine to alert for credits > $5k mapped to immediate recognition. filing revrec tech task.
Lina (Finance Lead): perfect. closing.
